title: DOH CLOSES LEGEND SEAFOOD RESTAURANT DUE TO MULTIPLE FOOD SAFETY VIOLATIONS
summary: HONOLULU — The Hawai‘i Department of Health (DOH) Food Safety Branch (FSB) issued a red “closed” placard and immediately shut down Legend Seafood Restaurant. The establishment, located at 100 N. Beretania St., Ste. 108, was shut down due multiple critical food safety violations. The food establishment, operated by Ming Dynasty Fish & Shrimp Co., Inc., […]
